api/src/repositories/__init__.py.name: Record access
api/src/repositories/__init__.py.description: Gathers the single place for each kind of record where it is read and written, so access rules are applied the same way everywhere.

api/src/repositories/agents.py.name: Agent records
api/src/repositories/agents.py.description: Creates, finds and updates assistants, keeping each one limited to the organizations and roles allowed to use it.

api/src/repositories/ai_usage.py.name: AI spend records
api/src/repositories/ai_usage.py.description: Records every AI call's usage and cost, and holds the price list used to work out what each run cost.

api/src/repositories/applications.py.name: App records
api/src/repositories/applications.py.description: Stores each app's details, versions and build state, and checks the caller may change them.

api/src/repositories/audit_logs.py.name: Activity history
api/src/repositories/audit_logs.py.description: Stores and searches the log of who changed what, grouped by person or record so admins can review it.

api/src/repositories/base.py.name: Shared record steps
api/src/repositories/base.py.description: Gives every kind of record the same basic create, read, update and delete steps.

api/src/repositories/branding.py.name: Brand settings
api/src/repositories/branding.py.description: Holds the platform-wide name, logos and colour choices that every screen and email uses.

api/src/repositories/config.py.name: Setting values
api/src/repositories/config.py.description: Reads and writes settings such as connection details and service passwords, and warns when a required one is missing.

api/src/repositories/data_providers.py.name: Lookup source list
api/src/repositories/data_providers.py.description: Keeps the catalogue of lookup sources that forms and workflows can offer as choices.

api/src/repositories/events.py.name: Event records
api/src/repositories/events.py.description: Stores where events come from, which workflows listen for them, and whether each event was delivered.

api/src/repositories/execution_logs.py.name: Run logs
api/src/repositories/execution_logs.py.description: Stores the log lines each run produces and pages through them in order for the run detail screen.

api/src/repositories/executions.py.name: Run records
api/src/repositories/executions.py.description: Creates, updates and lists workflow runs, including their status, results, timing and cost.

api/src/repositories/external_mcp.py.name: AI tool connections
api/src/repositories/external_mcp.py.description: Stores the outside tool catalogues assistants can use, each organization's connection and each person's own sign-in.

api/src/repositories/forms.py.name: Form records
api/src/repositories/forms.py.description: Creates, finds and updates forms with the same organization and role limits as the rest of the platform.

api/src/repositories/integrations.py.name: Integration records
api/src/repositories/integrations.py.description: Stores each outside service connection, the settings it needs, and which organization maps to which outside account.

api/src/repositories/knowledge.py.name: Knowledge documents
api/src/repositories/knowledge.py.description: Stores and searches the reference documents assistants draw on, including the pieces used for search.

api/src/repositories/oauth.py.name: Service sign-in passes
api/src/repositories/oauth.py.description: Stores the outside services people connect and the access passes kept for them, refreshing passes when they expire.

api/src/repositories/org_scoped.py.name: Organization-scoped records
api/src/repositories/org_scoped.py.description: The one shared gate every organization-owned record passes through to apply access rules and organization limits.

api/src/repositories/organizations.py.name: Customer organizations
api/src/repositories/organizations.py.description: Stores each customer organization and its settings, and looks them up by name or identifier.

api/src/repositories/policy_rule.py.name: Reusable access rules
api/src/repositories/policy_rule.py.description: Keeps named, reusable access rules that record and file policies can point to instead of repeating themselves.

api/src/repositories/solutions.py.name: Solution installs
api/src/repositories/solutions.py.description: Stores each installed Solution and the details needed to update or remove it.

api/src/repositories/tables.py.name: Custom table records
api/src/repositories/tables.py.description: Stores custom tables and their rows, and checks the caller may read or change each one.

api/src/repositories/users.py.name: Staff accounts
api/src/repositories/users.py.description: Stores staff accounts and looks them up for sign-in, roles and attribution.

api/src/repositories/workflows.py.name: Workflow register
api/src/repositories/workflows.py.description: Keeps the register of every runnable piece of code with its name, settings, owner and permissions.
